t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try to find out which gnomes provide more mushrooms than others. Use trial and error to place the gnomes is a hierarchy of value, choosing the gnomes that provide the highest yield.

vb_textbox.text: Pay attention to which gnome provides the most mushrooms. Use the x1 multiplier to gauge how valuable a gnome is. As the rounds progress, the value of gnomes can change. For example, a brown gnome may be worth more than a purple gnome at the start, but this could be flipped by the end of the round. As a tip, it is useful to constantly repeat the colour of the most valuable gnomes in your head. This makes it easier to remember and quickly choose the right decision.
